extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology from XML/PDF/supplement locators; computational MD support is kept separate from direct cell/bacterial assay evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Lead dimers show direct outer- and inner-membrane interaction/permeabilization evidence in bacterial assays.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=7:Interaction with the outer and inner membranes; xml:fig=3; xml:fig=4; xml:fig=5

mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is supported for lead dimers 6 and 7, not all synthesized analogues.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Lead dimers induce a bacterial stress response measured by reactive oxygen species assays.
direct_assay_types: CellROX reactive oxygen species flow cytometry
mechanism_claims.limitations: ROS evidence is an associated stress-response readout and is not used to replace the membrane-permeability mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Lead dimers disrupt bacterial morphology and preformed biofilms in imaging and crystal-violet assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm eradication is phenotype evidence; mechanism interpretation remains membrane-disruption associated.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: MD simulations support adsorption and permeation of peptide 7 in a mixed lipid membrane model with PG-enriched contacts.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational support is not classified as direct biological mechanism evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Lead dimers modulate LPS-stimulated macrophage nitric oxide production.
direct_assay_types: Griess nitric oxide assay in RAW264.7 cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: Recorded as host-response activity, not as the primary antibacterial killing mechanism.
